title: Regarding the graph text bug from v3.3
symptom: Starting from v3.3, for Dana R pump users, when the basal increases in the AAPS client app, the extended bolus is output as text instead of the increased basal graph. These texts overlap and are not visible. The same behavior occurs with AccuChek Insight pumps.
cause: The cause is likely that Dana R pumps use extended bolus when basal increases or decreases, and the AAPS client displays this as text instead of a graph.
fix: The issue was fixed by a commit referenced by MilosKozak: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/4e71ae0d29df5b8c214b92f9cd3fba0a3040ebb3
